title: Allah Ho Akbar Ayee Akbar ki Sada
body:
Ro Pari Syedaniya Sajdai Main Gir Kaar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy Bazu Kat Gayai Himat Na Hara
Zainab-o-Kulsoom Ka Wahid Sahara
Lot Ker Aaya Nahi Dera Pai Ja Kaar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aai Ali Kai Ladlai Khaimain Main Aao
Main Jiyun Ya Keh Marun Itna Batao
Cheen Li Zalim Nai Merai Sar Sai Chadar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Rasm-e-Ibrahim Kuch Aisee Ada Ki
Jab Ali Akber Na Baba Ko Sada Di
Hath Guthno Per Hain Aur Kandhai Pai Akbar.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Juram Mera Agar Masum Hai Yeh
Boond Pani Sai Magar Mehroom Hai Yeh
Shah Pu Karai Thaam Kai Hathon Main Asghar.
